CYD28-SD-FILES-LANDSCAPE-R2
LAB only — CYD 2.8 ST7789 R1 SD cold-boot recovery with landscape SD FILES rendering fix. Render dirty SD FILES directly to rotated physical TFT when multi-band memory recovery is active; invalidate FramePush and bound long filenames to prevent wrapped/overlapping rows.
Source PR #245 stacked on PR #241 and upstream Phase 1 PR #239; all are unmerged.
Require full exact-head CI, host rotation geometry regression, successful Build and release firmware (LAB), and preserved production root on Pages.
No production tag/release; no merge or branch deletion. Physical validation with SD inserted at cold boot and both display orientations is required.
